name: Gmail API
proposedUse: Send a user-reviewed message and optionally support explicitly approved sync features.
pricingEvidence: Google Workspace API quotas apply; commercial security/verification effort requires confirmation.
commercialUseStatus: Permitted subject to Google API Services User Data Policy and scope verification.
recommendation: Start with gmail.send only at the send moment; keep copy/mailto alternatives.

name: Greenhouse Job Board API
proposedUse: Ingest public employer job postings with source attribution.
authentication: Public GET endpoints; write endpoints differ
pricingEvidence: Public documentation does not establish HireNudge commercial partnership terms.
commercialUseStatus: Review employer terms, attribution, caching and commercial rights per use case.
recommendation: Use only after a documented source policy and freshness lifecycle.

name: Ashby public job postings API
proposedUse: Ingest public job-board postings from opted-in employer boards.
commercialUseStatus: Review terms, cache, attribution and deletion obligations.
recommendation: Pilot alongside Greenhouse with source-specific quality metrics.

name: Apify
proposedUse: Run governed extraction jobs only where source terms and rights permit.
pricingEvidence: Usage-based platform pricing; actor costs vary.
commercialUseStatus: Platform availability does not grant rights to scrape target sites.
recommendation: Do not make restricted scraping the core job-data strategy.

name: Fantastic Jobs / licensed job-data provider
proposedUse: Evaluate licensed aggregation for coverage, freshness and expiry handling.
apiAvailability: Commercial offering; exact API/partner terms require vendor confirmation.
pricingEvidence: Not publicly verified for HireNudge use.
commercialUseStatus: Contract, DPA, geographic rights and redistribution terms required.
recommendation: Run a 500-job quality and rights audit before selection.

name: Apollo
proposedUse: Discover a bounded set of relevant professional contacts for user-reviewed outreach.
pricingEvidence: Plan/credit/rate limits apply and require current commercial confirmation.
commercialUseStatus: Provider access does not create HireNudge lawful basis.
recommendation: Pilot one provider, country and recipient use case only after legal approval.

name: Hunter
proposedUse: Find and verify a narrowly scoped professional email address.
pricingEvidence: Credit and rate limits depend on plan.
commercialUseStatus: Use remains subject to provider and recipient-country requirements.
recommendation: Consider as a narrower finder/verifier alternative to broad enrichment.

name: Realtime voice and transcription models
proposedUse: Provide opt-in mock interview audio, transcription and descriptive feedback.
apiAvailability: Official APIs exist; final provider requires evaluation.
pricingEvidence: Usage-based; current model pricing must be confirmed before build.
commercialUseStatus: Subject to provider terms, retention controls and regional availability.
recommendation: Validate transcript-first practice before realtime voice.

name: v0 by Vercel
proposedUse: Generate and iterate interface prototypes that are reviewed and integrated into the product system.
apiAvailability: Product and platform availability; export/use depends on current plan.
pricingEvidence: Plan-based; confirm current limits before procurement.
commercialUseStatus: Review generated dependencies and asset licensing.
securityRequirements: Do not upload production user data
recommendation: Use for prototypes and component exploration, not as the design system source of truth.

name: Relume
proposedUse: Explore sitemap, wireframe and component structure.
apiAvailability: Design product; integrations depend on plan.
recommendation: Use for information-architecture exploration after positioning is selected.

name: 21st.dev
proposedUse: Reference reusable community UI components and patterns.
commercialUseStatus: Inspect each dependency and licence before use.
recommendation: Use selectively; adapt to HireNudge tokens and accessibility rules.

name: Remotion
proposedUse: Create code-driven product walkthroughs and social video variants.
pricingEvidence: Core and cloud/licensing terms differ; confirm production use.
commercialUseStatus: Review media asset and font licences.
recommendation: Use after the workflow and final UI are approved.

name: HyperFrames by HeyGen
proposedUse: Evaluate product-video production after messaging and claims are approved.
apiAvailability: Commercial product; HyperFrames capability requires plan confirmation.
recommendation: Use only for approved original creative, not competitor imitation.

name: Higgsfield
proposedUse: Create original brand assets and concept explorations.
pricingEvidence: Plan and output rights require current confirmation.
commercialUseStatus: Review commercial output, likeness and training terms.
securityRequirements: No private screenshots or user data
recommendation: Use for original assets after brand direction and claims review.

name: Vo
proposedUse: Team-described design tool; exact vendor and use are not confirmed.
commercialUseStatus: Do not procure or recommend until the exact product is identified.
legalDependencies: Terms and licence review after identification
recommendation: Confirm whether the team means v0 by Vercel or another product.

name: Grainrad
proposedUse: Team-described design/resource tool; exact vendor is not confirmed.
commercialUseStatus: Do not procure or recommend until identified.
legalDependencies: Terms and licence review after identification
recommendation: Confirm spelling, vendor and intended workflow.
